beats.headline: He opens the valve
beats.text: Carl and Donut are under the sand in the castle's basement, and the ceiling is about to come in. Carl sends Gwen a note. I open the valve, only part way. The water in the necropolis comes out through the drain the castle is built around, the castle washes away like sand under a hose, and everything in there, the two of them included, goes with the water into the ocean.

beats.headline: One of the three who go through the Gate
beats.text: Vadim ran. That leaves Carl, Katia and me against Lusca and all of her babies, and we kill her, and then we kill them. Then Carl opens the Gate. One step and the three of us are out of the water quadrant and standing in town. Something came through behind us. A god, the feral kind. That is going to be somebody's problem.

beats.headline: Anser's tomb
beats.text: Gwen, me and the team go into the subterranean level now it is dry. We loot what is left of the tomb raiders. Electrifying the water set off every trap. The tomb of Anser: a sarcophagus, the skeleton of a goose, a golden crown, unenchanted. Quetzalcoatlus's corpse has a partial map of the sixth floor, with coordinates for several locations.

beats.headline: The legs do not grow back
beats.text: Katia tells Carl that Daniel and I are getting hammered in the fight with the queen. We are. Gwen is dead, beside the knock-knock joke man. My legs are gone. I drag myself away, screaming. Carl reads a scroll over me and it heals me. The legs do not grow back.

beats.headline: A floating chair
beats.text: Final moments of the last floor, I lost my legs. And Gwen. We'd been together since early on. Bautista is with me, helping. I open my boxes. The pacifist box has a floating wheelchair, the same sort Odette used to zip around in when she was in human form. Carl sends a note asking if I'm okay. I don't answer.

beats.headline: The wheelchair goes off
beats.text: The roof gives out under us and I fall down to a different level. The wheelchair is sparking. I'm stuck in it and it's going to blow. Louis and Britney keep running, because the monk seal is after Louis. The rock monster the demon summoned first, the one that crashed through the ceiling, is down here too. The wheelchair blows a hole in its chest. That was the last of his totems. I need a healer.

beats.headline: Blow the line
beats.text: Katia finished my chair. Two parts. A crab body for walls and short sprints, and a battle shell that closes over it up to a helmet, so much metal I can't carry a ranged weapon or the system calls me armour. The pets hit the dirt wall. I call for my moles. They go down the holes and come back faster than expected. Fire in the hole. The whole line goes up, and the dirt hangs over us on the shields. We set those explosives two hours ago. We were saving them.

beats.headline: The southern map
beats.text: Their trenches, here. The Dream's artillery on the hills: about forty big trebuchets, dozens of small ones. Fifty zebras with mercenary riders, held in reserve. Twenty tanks that have not moved since they were uncovered. A hundred of the Madness gone invisible. The first trench is NPCs and mercenaries, mostly Prism banners, one naga standard. No inner-circle officers. Their fallback trenches are a hundred metres apart, no tunnels we know of. I still don't understand why they get trebuchets and we don't.

beats.headline: Five teams of twenty-four
beats.text: If this is my last message, know that I tried to stop them fighting Li Na. I tried. Then, after: I'm alive. We won. Zhang was leading their octopus and let me pass. They tried to stop her, and it went the way it went in Beijing. She cast a dread and they killed each other. Of twenty-four teams that started, five are left. From our heat, only my team and theirs. Zhang needs help. He was sobbing. I don't know what to do.

beats.headline: Not bad, just lost
beats.text: Zhang says it's his fault. It isn't. It isn't all Na's, either. They attacked her. Rezan was an ass, and the decapitator had it coming. She didn't take player-killer skulls, because it was her dreads that did it, and they all killed each other. Zhang wants to kill their mount mid-race so the system takes them both. Carl says that won't work any more: Na just loses containment and reaches the line without one. She isn't killing for fun. She's lost her humanity. Those are different problems.

beats.headline: A red shirt for the Cabaret
beats.text: Two hundred of us are going to the Pineapple Cabaret, and I am one of them, spider legs and all. Carl calls Zhang and me generals. Zhang reminds him he was only ever made colonel. Carl says he sees I'm wearing a red shirt now. I hold out my arms and ask how he likes it. Donut headbutts me. Then Bautista pours the tea. That is the goodbye. It is enough of one.
